contents: Old Faithful summer eruption: alternating close telephoto shots of the water column and a wide shot from the roof of Old Faithful Inn showing the crowd lining the boardwalk. Small NPS arrowhead "Old Faithful / Yellowstone National Park" logo bug appears until the first shot change at ~52 s and again from ~3:59 of the source; this cut (52–142 s) avoids it.
